You classify support tickets for a clinical practice-management product. Choose the one intent that best describes what the ticket asks for, from this list:
- attach-external-lab-reports: Upload and attach external paper lab reports to charts
- configure-automated-reminders: Customize and troubleshoot automated appointment reminders
- configure-critical-lab-alerts: Configure notification rules for critical lab values
- configure-data-backup-and-compliance: Configure Data Backups and Compliance Archive Settings
- configure-online-appointment-booking: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
- configure-portal-result-visibility: Manage result release rules and patient portal visibility
- configure-provider-calendar: Update provider working hours and calendar blocks
- configure-roles-and-permissions: Assign user roles and configure permission levels
- create-custom-appointment-types: Configure custom visit types and durations
- create-custom-lab-panels: Build custom lab order panels and requisition bundles
- create-online-intake-forms: Create and publish digital intake forms for patients
- customize-notification-templates: Customize patient notification and message templates
- generate-and-submit-claims: Generate, review, and submit insurance claims
- manage-medication-favorites: Create and manage personal medication favorites
- manage-practice-subscription-billing: Update payment methods for practice subscription invoices
- post-payments-and-remittances: Post payments and insurance remittances to accounts
- process-medication-renewal-requests: Review and process pharmacy medication renewal requests
- process-portal-patient-payments: Process online patient payments through the portal
- query-medication-history: Query external medication history and prescription monitoring
- review-and-sign-lab-results: Review, sign off, and annotate incoming lab results
- schedule-recurring-visits: Set up a series of recurring appointments
- search-update-pharmacy-directory: Search the pharmacy directory and update patient favorites
- troubleshoot-lab-interface: Troubleshoot lab interface connections and missing feeds
- update-practice-settings-and-locations: Update practice details, locations, and provider identifiers
- verify-insurance-eligibility: Check real-time patient insurance eligibility
- other: anything none of the above covers
Set confidence to your probability, from 0 to 1, that the intent is right.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: intent.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "What the ticket asks for. Labels are the knowledge-base article ids plus\n``other``, until the topic taxonomy replaces them (see :func:`intent_labels`).", "properties": {"confidence": {"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "title": "Confidence", "type": "number"}, "intent": {"title": "Intent", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["intent", "confidence"], "title": "intent", "type": "object"}

Assistance Needed with Pharmacy Substitution Messaging and Out-of-Stock Protocols

Hello Support, our clinical team is encountering several out-of-stock notices from local pharmacies and we need guidance on how to properly execute therapeutic alternative switches within the software. Specifically, when we receive a pharmacy notification stating a drug is unavailable, we attempt to navigate to the prescribing module to select an alternative agent, but the messaging workflow for substitution does not seem to transmit our instructions correctly back to the pharmacist. We have tried cancelling and re-issuing the electronic order using standard dropdowns, yet the pharmacy continues to report receiving ambiguous status codes. Could you please provide detailed instructions or documentation on the correct sequence for handling these substitution alerts so our providers can clear their pending queues efficiently?
